speaker: will_kemp
text: Sweet Master Shakespeare. And a scarf on the sweet tooth. I said it would be daily. Sunday was church. Monday is mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have your day, Will. The scarf is the jaw, not a property. I am here by ten, as I meant to be.

speaker: john_heminges
text: By ten. Good. Navarre at two. The book is the book. I do not need Raleigh in it, whatever the river is selling.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The river sold me a ship of gold. Paul's sold me little riches and a blank quire at fivepence. I bought the quire. I am not buying a new play before dinner.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art wrapped like a man with one side to lend. Does the scarf come off before the oath, or dost thou mean to swear through wool?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It comes off for the oath. It goes on again the moment I am out of the light. Thou wilt have the words. Thou wilt not have the tooth.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A Cambridge man called him sweet, and now he rations his own face. There is a comedy in it, and I am not offered the roll.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You are offered the jig, as you were offered it on Saturday. Navarre is his. The plot does not have your name on it, Will, sweet or otherwise. Abel scraped that.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Fivepence for paper, and the news shrunk between stair and pillar. Go and eat. Thou canst not play a king on a story and a clove.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can play him on the book. Little riches. I asked if any man there had spoken with a sailor off the ship. None had.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then none of it goes in the company book. Eat. Be back for two. The scarf is your own business until then.
